parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 2000,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": {{ JSON.stringify(
        "Create a concise weekly development summary for the GitHub repository " +
        $json.repository +
        ".\n\nReporting period: " +
        $json.period_start +
        " to " +
        $json.period_end +
        ".\n\nLanguage: " +
        $json.language +
        ".\n\nCommits: " +
        $json.commit_count +
        "\nClosed issues: " +
        $json.closed_issue_count +
        "\nMerged pull requests: " +
        $json.merged_pr_count +
        "\n\nCommit details:\n" +
        JSON.stringify($json.commits) +
        "\n\nClosed issue details:\n" +
        JSON.stringify($json.issues) +
        "\n\nMerged pull request details:\n" +
        JSON.stringify($json.pull_requests) +
        "\n\nWrite a concise, factual developer-facing weekly summary in the specified language (EN or FR) based only on the provided data. Do not speculate or add recommendations. If a category has no items, explicitly say there were none during this period."
      ) }}
    }
  ]
}
